proposed_owner_decision.reasonApprovalRequired: Owner F.1/G.0 instruction expressly retains the current fixed CLI and LPAC isolation boundary; removing login-stage LPAC requires a new decision
proposed_owner_decision.reference: Historical gogo-party PROVIDER_LOGIN uses ordinary codex login in an instance home; fixed official CLI supports browser OAuth. Design37 section9 keeps instance homes separate from daily CLI homes and credentials vendor-owned
proposed_owner_decision.change: Only Owner-initiated login: same fixed CLI and original registered instance home, normal current-user process without LPAC or its shim. Keep native process custody, fixed login arguments, persistent session, cancellation, original error and automatic status readback
proposed_owner_decision.permissionEffect: Login process receives normal current-user filesystem rights and no longer has LPAC file isolation during login; no elevation
preserved: Model/seat sessions and account-read retain existing LPAC profile/capabilities
